description: This file contains Makefile snippets and macro definitions related to building and managing root filesystem images, including conditional compilation for MKLIBS, package management commands (opkg, apk), and root filesystem preparation routines.

methods.name: mklibs
methods.description: Defines a macro to build and strip libraries using mklibs, including finding executables and shared objects, and copying them to target directories.

methods.name: opkg
methods.description: Defines a macro for package management using opkg with specific options for offline root and package addition.

methods.name: apk
methods.description: Defines a macro for package management using apk with options for root, keys, and cache preservation.

methods.name: clean_ipkg
methods.description: Defines a macro to clean up opkg package info files and status, removing unnecessary files and resetting status entries.

methods.name: prepare_rootfs
methods.description: Defines a macro to prepare the root filesystem, including copying files, running post-install scripts, enabling/disabling init scripts, cleaning up version control directories, and invoking cleanup and library build routines.
